courses.title: Defensible Use of Force: Standards, Decisions, and Documentation
courses.format: Online, asynchronous. Scenarios, knowledge checks, written skill test, graded final, certificate.
courses.summary: Make force decisions that hold up on the reasonable-officer standard, apply the Graham factors and Title 15 to custody encounters, and document decisions so they are deposition-ready.
outcomes: Apply the reasonable-officer standard to custody encounters
Apply Graham factors and Title 15 to institutional force decisions
Document decisions with the 8355 Framework

courses.title: Defensible Use of Force: Standards, Decisions, and Documentation
courses.format: Online, asynchronous. Scenarios, knowledge checks, written skill test, graded final, certificate.
courses.audience: Probation field and community corrections officers
courses.summary: Judge force by the reasonable-officer standard and handle force-or-disengage decisions that survive review.
outcomes: Judge force by the reasonable-officer standard
Handle force-or-disengage decisions that survive review
Document field force decisions defensibly

courses.title: De-escalation and Crisis Intervention for Juvenile Institutions

outcomes: Recognize escalation early and intervene
Document de-escalation under Title 15, PC 835a, and SB 230

courses.title: Preventing Manipulation and Grooming in Juvenile Facilities
courses.format: Online, asynchronous, with knowledge checks and certificate.
courses.audience: Juvenile facility staff, supervisors, and training officers
courses.summary: How youth in custody identify, target, and compromise staff, and how to interrupt the process early. Built around the Downing the Duck six-stage framework.
outcomes: Recognize the six stages of staff manipulation
Report early-stage indicators without hesitation
Supervise for isolation and rule-bending indicators

courses.title: PREA Compliance for Juvenile Facilities
courses.format: Online, asynchronous, with knowledge checks and certificate.
courses.summary: Prison Rape Elimination Act standards applied to juvenile facilities: duty to protect, risk identification, classification and housing, supervision, reporting, and response.
outcomes: Apply PREA standards to daily supervision
Identify risk and respond to reports correctly
Document compliance defensibly

courses.title: Interacting with Americans with Disabilities
courses.hours: 4 hr classroom, 8 hr with practical block
courses.format: STC-approved in-person course in 4-hour and 8-hour formats. Online version of the 4-hour classroom block in development.
courses.summary: Title II obligations, hidden disabilities, the safety-first threshold, the four-step interactive process, effective communication, mobility, search and transport, and defensible documentation.
outcomes: Explain when the duty to accommodate attaches
Run and document the four-step interactive process
Search and transport a person with a mobility device

courses.title: Cultural Diversity and Bias
courses.format: STC-approved in-person course. Online version fully scripted and in production.
courses.summary: Bias awareness and cultural competence for supervision and custody settings, taught for defensibility and daily practice.
outcomes: Recognize bias in decisions and documentation
Apply culturally competent communication

courses.title: Building Ethical Leaders and Professionalism
courses.format: STC-approved in-person course. Online version fully scripted and in production.
courses.summary: A four-step ethical decision model, duty to intervene, and a repeatable structure for hard conversations with subordinates and peers.
outcomes: Apply a four-step ethical decision model
Deliver a correction using a repeatable structure

courses.title: Chemical Agents
courses.format: In-person, with POST expanded course outline.
courses.audience: Institution and field staff authorized to carry chemical agents
courses.summary: Deployment, decontamination, documentation, and liability for chemical agents in custody and field settings.
outcomes: Deploy and decontaminate correctly
Document deployments defensibly
